lines.zh: 轮子转一格，我往前挪一格。
lines.en: One turn of the wheels, one block forward.

lines.zh: 木架压得吱响，我慢慢移。
lines.en: The frame groans as I shift along.
Three people push me before I move.
I shuffle along the foot of the wall.

lines.zh: 轮子陷进泥里，我停了一下。
lines.en: A wheel sinks in mud and I pause.
Turning, I drag out an arc.
My ropes tauten and slacken.
Low-slung, I move very steadily.
A stone rolls in my basket.

lines.zh: 我靠人腿走路，可没人敢近。
lines.en: I walk on other legs, and no one comes near.
On the slope I nearly stall.

lines.zh: 我压过草，草都倒伏下来。
lines.en: I roll over grass and it lies flat.
The torsion bundle is wound; I hold the tension.

lines.zh: 我对着那个方向，一动不动。
lines.en: I face that direction without moving.

lines.zh: 绳子拉得很紧，木头在响。
lines.en: The ropes are tight and the wood creaks.
I'm waiting for the order.
The stone is already in my trough.
I lean back a little, storing force.

lines.zh: 没人碰我，我就这样绷着。
lines.en: Nobody touches me, so I stay wound.
The wind hums through my ropes.
The wedge still sits in place.
I ease off half an inch.
A bird perches on my arm.
I can see the far walls.

lines.zh: 我的影子躺在地上，很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on the ground.
I wait for someone to trip the lever.

lines.zh: 站到侧面去，别站在前面。
lines.en: Get to my side, not in front.

lines.zh: 我的臂朝着那边，不是朝你。
lines.en: My arm points that way, not at you.
You're standing on my rope.
I'm not wound yet; don't panic.
Look at this stone — it's heavy.

lines.zh: 我转不了身，只能等人推。
lines.en: I can't turn myself; I need to be pushed.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，震起来会伤到你。
lines.en: You're too close; the recoil will hurt you.
I know which way a siege should point.

lines.zh: 你要不要试试拉这根绳？
lines.en: Care to pull this rope?
There's a whole crew behind me.
There's old blood on my frame.

lines.zh: 我一点声音都没有，这不正常。
lines.en: I make no sound at all — that's unusual.
Your hand is on the release.
I'm under tension; best not to touch.
I've tipped a little this way.

lines.zh: 你从正面看，会看不清石头。
lines.en: From the front you'd never see the stone coming.
I'm waiting for you to say fire.

lines.zh: 你离得太近，我看不见你。
lines.en: You're too close for me to see you.
A blow hits my frame and it skews.
My rope slips half a turn.
I rock and settle again.
A wooden pin flies out.
Some tension bleeds out of the bundle.
My aim's off; I need to reset.
The wheels spin half a turn.
I can still be wound.
The wood's split, but it holds.
My frame jolts and the aim drifts.
Give me another stone.
This one's too small to fly far.
I prefer round ones; they fly true.
Set it in the trough.
The rope's slack; another turn of the winch.
Can you lift it? I'll use the sling.

lines.zh: 这块石头的弧线会很好。
lines.en: This one will fly a beautiful arc.
Don't set it crooked; it'll drift.
I smell pitch.
I'm confident about this shot.

lines.zh: 你撞在木架上，肩膀会疼。
lines.en: You hit my frame; your shoulder will ache.
My spokes are jammed; I cannot move.
My ropes swing from the jolt.
Don't push that side; it skews me.
You knocked me half an inch round.
The wedge has loosened a bit.
Your foot's caught in my spokes.
I can't shift sideways.
That cost me my aim.
You're far lighter than a stone.
Two catapults stand side by side.
Both torsion bundles wind tight together.

lines.zh: 我们的投掷弧线可以互相交叉。
lines.en: Our arcs can cross each other.
A crew pulls both ropes at once.
One target, two stones.
Wood against wood — very steady.
Nobody winds us at night.
Tomorrow we break that keep together.

lines.zh: 我们之间的空隙只容一人。
lines.en: Only one person fits between us.
Two engines, one intent.
A stone rolls into my trough.
I'm resting on that rope end.
A wedge has been squeezed out.
This stone is cracked; no good.
I can hold it; let it down.
There are already two in my basket.
It's wedged under a wheel.
I've carried it into the trough.
Someone else threw this one.
Too heavy; the basket's creaking.
Banners move on the wall.
I raise my arm.
The stone is pushed all the way back.
Everyone's behind the ropes.

lines.zh: 那个位置，正是我的角度。
lines.en: That spot — exactly my angle.
I cinch the torsion tight.

lines.zh: 城门上有裂缝，就是那里。
lines.en: There's a crack above the gate — there.

lines.zh: 扭杆压到底，我等这一放
lines.en: The torsion is wound tight; I wait for the release.
One degree higher on this angle.
The wedge goes to its last notch.
Everyone's looking at me.

lines.zh: 我的臂绷住了，木头在响。
lines.en: My arm locks and the wood groans.
Every hand on the rope tightens.
This one's for the wall.
I count the range: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 我在等他们推得再近一点。
lines.en: I wait for them to come closer.

lines.zh: 风偏了一点，我修正半度。
lines.en: The wind shifted; I correct half a degree.
My arm stays up.

lines.zh: 他们以为我打不到那么远。
lines.en: They think I can't reach that far.
The stone wobbles slightly in the trough.
I watch the gate, not the people.
The hands on the rope are shaking.
A moment longer — let them form up.

lines.zh: 这个仰角我调过了三遍。
lines.en: I've adjusted this elevation three times.
That brick in the wall is new.
I'm fixed on that gap.
Someone's raising a shield up top.

lines.zh: 风从左边来，会把它推过去。
lines.en: Wind from the left will carry it over.
My hand stays on the release.
A little more, just a little more.

lines.zh: 石弹的弧线我算得很准。
lines.en: I've calculated the arc precisely.
They're moving forward now.
I wait for them to cross that line.
This is the best moment.

lines.zh: 我松手之前，会先停一下。
lines.en: Before I let go, I'll pause.
The torsion releases and my arm snaps out.
The stone leaves the trough with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 整架木车往后跳了一下。
lines.en: The whole frame jumps backward.
The rope whips back and strikes the ground.
The stone climbs higher and higher.
It hits the wall and bricks spray.
That shot landed clean.
Debris falls like rain.
My frame is trembling.
The crew's already rewinding.
The stone has gouged out a crater.
The smell of hot wood is good.
They'll remember that one.
I lower my arm slowly.
One more stone.

lines.zh: 石弹碎了，可它已经打中了。
lines.en: The stone shattered — but it hit.
The crew starts cheering.

lines.zh: 木架立起来，轮子先着地。
lines.en: The frame rises and the wheels land first.
My sling hangs down, still swinging.
The torsion bundle is new and wound tight.
I take position outside the walls.
Someone starts winding the ropes.
I raise my arm to the top.

lines.zh: 木头还带着新削的味道。
lines.en: The wood still smells freshly cut.
The ground under me is hard and firm.
A stone is set before me.
The far gate is shut.
A crew gathers around me.
I've picked out my target.

lines.zh: 我压了压木楔，试试手感。
lines.en: I tap the wedge to test the feel.
The rope hums taut.
The wind makes my shadow waver.
Someone calls out to ready.
I slowly true up my aim.
The first shot is for the wall.

lines.zh: 绳子先烧起来，火顺着木架爬。
lines.en: The rope catches first and fire climbs the frame.
The frame crashes down and half of it breaks.

lines.zh: 水把木架泡软了，我塌下去。
lines.en: Water softens the wood and I sag.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的臂掀翻过去。
lines.en: The blast throws my arm right over.

lines.zh: 一支火箭钉在我的槽上。
lines.en: A fire arrow sticks in my trough.

lines.zh: 绳子自己在收紧，不听使唤。
lines.en: The ropes tighten on their own.

lines.zh: 没有石弹，我只是一堆木头。
lines.en: Without stones I'm just a pile of timber.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整架都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole frame jumps.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我整架往下落。
lines.en: The ground's gone and the whole frame drops.
